== Summary ==
Identified: [[Kevin Jaap]] (seated, bald, glasses, and a grey tee; same face as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 17.jpg]] and [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 22.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the player in an Obi-Wan Kenobi shirt (same man as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 7.jpg]]).
Players with costumed Star Wars characters (scout troopers, a Jawa and others) at Zu Den Vier Winden, Bochum, during the [[2022 European Championship]]. Posted by tge.damen after the event; the people are not named.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-09-12
